title: 택시에서: 가 주세요, 세워 주세요
summary: A short taxi ride: say where you're going, answer the driver's route question, ask to stop, and pay.
objective: In a taxi, say your destination with '○○(으)로 가 주세요', answer the driver's route question, and ask to stop with '○○ 앞에서 세워 주세요'.
setting: Inside a taxi in Seoul, from getting in to paying and getting out.

dialogue.meaning: Exit 3 of City Hall Station, please.
Okay. Which way should I go?

dialogue.korean: 잘 모르겠어요. 빠른 길로 가 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: I'm not sure. Please take the fastest way.

dialogue.korean: 거의 다 왔어요. 어디에서 세워 드릴까요?
dialogue.meaning: We're almost there. Where should I stop?
Please stop in front of that convenience store up there.
Okay, here we are. Will you pay by card?

dialogue.korean: 카드를 여기에 대 주세요. 안녕히 가세요.
dialogue.meaning: Please tap your card here. Goodbye.
Thank you. Have a good day.

words.exampleMeaning: Which side is the hotel entrance on?
I'm late. Please take the fastest way.
That building up ahead is my office.
Just a little longer. We're almost there.
Oh, I'll get out here. Thank you.
I don't have any cash. I'll pay by card.

words.meaning: please tap (your card on the reader)
words.exampleMeaning: Please tap your transit card here.

task.title: Talk to the taxi driver
task.line: Use the words and the dialogue above to fill in, answer, or put in order each item.

exercises: Fill in the blanks with 로 or 으로 (use 로 after a vowel or ㄹ, and 으로 after any other final consonant): 명동____ 가 주세요. / 호텔____ 가 주세요.
Answer the driver. You don't know the way, so ask for the fastest route: 기사: 어느 쪽으로 갈까요? → 손님: 잘 모르겠어요. ____________.
Ask the driver to stop in front of the bank (bank = 은행): 기사: 어디에서 세워 드릴까요? → 손님: ____________.
Put the lines in the right order: (a) 저기 앞에서 세워 주세요. (b) 어서 오세요. 어디로 가세요? (c) 거의 다 왔어요. (d) 서울역으로 가 주세요.
You want to pay in cash, not by card. Answer the driver (cash = 현금): 기사: 카드로 하실 거예요? → 손님: 아니요, ____________.
answers: 은행 앞에서 세워 주세요. (은행 앞에서 내릴게요.)
